This practical decoy dispenser tool is manufactured by Omegaton Industries. It’s the ultimate gadget for surviving potentially lethal encounters. It will give the user a chance to escape if chased by a faster and overwhelming hostile opponent, such as a large animal or similar creature. When used the tool will eject a small Decoy as the user is running away. The decoy is designed to transmit various impulses on different frequencies that are able to annoy and distract most aggressive pursuers enough to trick them to a standstill, giving the user time to escape to safety. Decoys need to be purchased separately.

Doctor Geovana D´Raay works as a prominent medical executive at the health department on Calypso. She also has a degree in medical engineering, which has made her a strong supporter of new technological development in all areas that can help improve personal medical equipment and the public health. She has been the driving force behind this improved first aid kit, which has a new and more efficient StimGene Pulse System making this model more efficient than the original one.  Unfortunately it’s very expensive to upgrade and improve the old Fast Aid Pack’s and the lack of new financial aid and interest has made this a rare tool despite Dr. D´Raay’s relentless efforts to gain wider support for the project.

Doctor Jagaar Ivel Dithaal was an infamous makeshift engineering and self-proclaimed genius. He wanted to modify the StimGene Pulse System on a standard first aid kit in an attempt to extract information from the “xeno-energy patterns” that he claimed were present inside the altered genes of all mutants on Calypso. By planting these modified versions inside mutant areas he hoped to gain proof for his theory. News of his experiments leaked out and Omegaton Industries were enraged at having their products spread out amongst mutants. The experiment was shut down and Dr. Dithaal was arrested and sent to a mental correction institution, many of his modified Fast Aid Packs are however still unaccounted for. On very rare occasions these tools find their way back into human hands. The modified versions appear to be fully functional and are very efficient, even though Omegaton Industries strongly advice people not to use them.

His philosophy is that all tools can be adjusted for more efficient use, and if you bought it you own it and can do whatever you want with it, much to the general displeasure of most product manufacturers. Old Bubba has made himself a name on Calypso, not as a miner but as a makeshift engineer, and his adjusted mineral extractors are considered valuable finds these days.

Genesis Star Interstellar is the proud designer of this mineral extraction tool. It utilizes a combined laser and particle beam to extract ore from underground deposits. This type of hardware is necessary for exploiting natural mineral resources, and it has been the task of Genesis Star to bring this highly vital product to the market. To function, this tool first requires target data from a Claim Rod, and such data can only be obtained using a separate mineral detector of an inferior brand. Fortunately this excellent piece of multi-compatible hardware can compensate for any lack of quality in these other products, giving the user of this product a very reliable personal mining tool. Point the tool towards a Claim Rod marking your mineral deposit and press the assigned action button to extract ore.

Goot, a subsidiary to Genesis Star, made this generic refiner tool for the processing of various tailoring raw materials. The refiner is capable of processing a large variety of raw materials into useable items for various clothes.

The Bergstrom Frontier Development Group has improved this refiner in association with the Chikara OmniWorld Corporation. The Bergstrom Frontier Development Group had already proven their capabilities to the Chikara OmniWorld Corporation by successfully improving one of their other products. Despite the difference in the functionality of this tool and previous models, the developers managed to make several improvements. It seems a bit strange that the company is only allowed to make a limited number of the improved version, as if to test their skills. Rumors have it that there might be more going on between the big corporation and the small company than just business.

A small company called Frontier ExcaPro Ventures, led by a resourceful man named Vincent Rayne, decided to improve the Genesis Star Earth Excavator. His group developed a new master-chip in an attempt to create a cheap upgrade by fine-tuning the specs of the original design. Once the chip hit the market it didn’t take long before Genesis Star performed a hostile takeover of the company and the production was terminated. Despite this shutdown a lot of the new master-chips still circulate and improved versions of this mineral extractor can still be found on the market, even though they remain quite rare.

Inspired by the previous task of increasing the detonation range on seismic charges, the chief-engineer at Omegaton Industries, Gainax Gray, managed to persuade the board of directors to finance another improved version of their mineral detector. This tool was equipped with a new detection unit with increased sensitivity allowing the tool to receive seismic signals from an even longer range. The other corporations complained however, that this enhanced tool could have a negative affect on the market balance on Calypso, creating overproduction of mineral ore that would eventually dump the prices. True or false, this report made the planetary authorities force Omegaton Industries to withdraw the new improved version from the open market. Despite this action, quite a large number of units had already been sold and are still in circulation.

This mineral detector was originally developed by Omegaton Industries to find new mineral deposits. It’s designed for seismic surveys using the Omegaton Seismic Bomb. When the bomb has been remotely detonated the tool can pick up signals from various types of ore hidden deep under the ground. Upon detecting a deposit the tool is able to track the signal to its source. This tool can then be used to mark the site and generate a legal documentation of the find to verify the ownership of the site. It’s always necessary to claim the find before an excavation can be initiated. Excavating ore from a mineral deposit requires a mineral extraction tool, which must be purchased separately.

The Omegaton EnMatter Detector is used for detecting energy matter in the ground. It has to be used together with an Omegaton Survey Probe, which is purchased separately. When used, the probe will survey the ground for energy matter and if such a deposit is detected, it will send the information to this tool. This tool can then be used to mark the site and generate a legal documentation of the find to verify the ownership of the site. It’s always necessary to claim the find before an excavation can be initiated. Excavating energy matter from a deposit requires an energy matter extraction tool, which must be purchased separately.
